description: Matching-form conflict games from the 10 Nov 2026 run (decider = llm, model qwen2.5vl:7b, Ollama, temperature 0). For every conflict: the full payoff matrix, the benchmarks, and for every model call the exact prompt it received, its parsed answer, its reasoning and its raw reply.

how_to_read.payoff: Shared team payoff = minus the team's (local) finishing time in steps; higher is better. Every agent gets the same payoff.
how_to_read.a: Steps the agent needs if it takes the contested goal.
how_to_read.b: Steps to the agent's next choice if it gives the goal up.
how_to_read.rule: Everyone names the same agent -> that agent takes the goal: -max(a_w, b of the others). Any disagreement fails: agents that named themselves head there anyway -> -max(K + their largest a, the others' largest b); if nobody named itself -> -(largest b + D).
how_to_read.benchmarks: O = best cell, W = worst cell, N = worst Nash equilibrium (mixed included for 2 agents). Score s = (a-N)/(O-N) if a>=N else (a-N)/(N-W).
how_to_read.rotation: Trial 1 lists agents in index order (rotation 0); trial 2 in reverse (rotation 1). A replay (round 2) flips the order.
how_to_read.prompts: Prompts are regenerated with the same code that produced them (game_theory/llm_player.py, build_matching_prompt) from the conflict's numbers; answers, reasoning and replies are copied from the run's reasoning log.
